description: The edge a TmSidePanel belongs to: a right-hand inspector (the default) or a left-hand navigation / task panel. It decides which edge the side sheet slides in from.

members.name: Left
members.description: The panel sits on the left edge of its host; its side sheet slides in from the left.

members.name: Right
members.description: The panel sits on the right edge of its host; its side sheet slides in from the right.
